method: Canvas runs are pinned to the original seven run IDs and verified against each named workflow issue; auxiliary and rework runs are excluded. Read-only server issue descriptions/comments are compared against parsed Codex final output field strings after trimming boundary whitespace. Only hashes, lengths, identifiers and declared field metadata are saved. Artifact snapshots prove local file presence, with timestamps distinguishing historical files, writes within the pinned run and subsequent rework. Provider run completion does not by itself establish product acceptance; issueStatus is reported separately.
